parts.text: Several customers were kicked out of the Walmart for refusing to wear masks.
A number equals four times that many minus 5 were kicked out for shoplifting.
Three times the number of shoplifters were kicked out for physical violence over goods on sale.
If a total of 50 people were kicked out of the Walmart, and 19 people were kicked out for other reasons, how many customers were asked to leave for not wearing masks?

parts.text: Three individuals were expelled from Walmart for not complying with the mask mandate.
The number of people caught shoplifting was four times the number of those not wearing masks, reduced by five.
The count of those removed for engaging in physical altercations over discounted items was three times the number of shoplifters.
Given that the total number of people asked to leave Walmart was 50, can you determine how many were ejected for reasons not mentioned above?

parts.text: Hallie had dance practice for 2 hours on Tuesdays and 3 hours on Thursdays.
On Saturdays, she had dance practice that lasted twice as long as Tuesday's night class.
How many hours a week did she have dance practice?
